source: Frozen NASA POWER daily regional 10 m wind, 1985–2025
date_basis: UTC daily source dates grouped by calendar month, not local hourly weather

units.speed_m_s: m/s, 10 m daily-mean wind summarized by month
units.from_deg: meteorological direction FROM, clockwise from true north
units.shortwave_daily_mean_MJ_m2_day: regional monthly mean of daily all-sky surface shortwave, MJ/m²/day; NOT instantaneous scene irradiance or cloud observation

calm_rule: WS10M dailymean < 0.5 m/s excluded from direction bins; monthly mean speed retains all valid days
bin_rule: 16 equal 22.5 degree sectors, north centered at 0 degrees; floor(((WD mod 360)+11.25)/22.5) mod16
denominator: valid non-calm DAYS in each month; not hourly duration or instantaneous wind frequency
display_rule: Spatial density or sequential representative arrows may reflect bin proportions, but are regional background illustrations, not local CFD or actual chronology. All nonzero bins are retained.
